-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvTrace` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def tracingEventRep (p : Loc) (e : TraceEv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ g a b,
      typedPointsto p g DFrac.discard ∗
        ⌜g.Name' = e.name ∧
              g.NodeID' = e.nid ∧
                g.State'.Term' = e.term ∧
                  g.State'.Vote' = e.vote ∧
                    g.State'.Commit' = e.commit ∧ g.Role' = e.role ∧ g.LogSize' = e.logSize ∧ g.Conf'.arr = [a, b]⌝ ∗
          ownSlice a e.conf.fst DFrac.discard ∗
            ownSlice b e.conf.snd DFrac.discard ∗
              tracingMsgRep g.Message' e.msg ∗ tracingCCRep g.ConfChange' e.cc ∗ tracingPropsRep g.Properties' e)

theorem trace_append (γt : GName) (L : List TraceEv) (e : TraceEv) : ⊢ traceAuth γt L -∗ traceFrag
    γt L ==∗ traceAuth γt (L ++ [e]) ∗ traceFrag γt (L ++ [e])

def traceMsg_countable : Pos.Countable TraceMsg :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun m => (m.typ, m.term, m.frm, m.to, m.entries, m.logTerm, m.index, m.commit, m.vote, m.reject, m.rejectHint))
    (fun p =>
      { typ := p.fst, term := p.snd.fst, frm := p.snd.snd.fst, to := p.snd.snd.snd.fst, entries := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        logTerm := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, index := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        commit := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, vote := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        reject := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, rejectHint := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    traceMsg_countable._proof_1

structure TraceEv : Type where
  name : GoString
  nid : GoString
  term : w64
  vote : GoString
  commit : w64
  role : GoString
  logSize : w64
  conf : List GoString × List GoString
  msg : Option TraceMsg
  cc : Option TraceCC
  propCC : Option TraceCC
  propMatch : Option w64
  propNext : Option w64

def tracingPropsRep (m : GoMap) (e : TraceEv) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m = null⌝ ∗ ⌜e.propCC = none ∧ e.propMatch = none ∧ e.propNext = none⌝ ∨
      ∃ pm pc,
        ownMap m DFrac.discard pm ∗
          ⌜(e.propCC.isSome = true ↔
                  pm !! go!"cc" = some (interface.mkOk TracingConfChange.ty.PointerType (intoVal pc))) ∧
                (e.propCC.isNone = true → pm !! go!"cc" = none) ∧
                  (∀ (w : w64),
                      e.propMatch = some w ↔
                        pm !! go!"match" = some (interface.mkOk go.uint64 (intoVal w))) ∧
                    (e.propMatch = none → pm !! go!"match" = none) ∧
                      (∀ (w : w64),
                          e.propNext = some w ↔
                            pm !! go!"next" = some (interface.mkOk go.uint64 (intoVal w))) ∧
                        (e.propNext = none → pm !! go!"next" = none) ∧
                          ∀ (k : List w8),
                            ¬k ∈ [go!"cc", go!"match", go!"next"] →
                              pm !! k = none⌝ ∗
            tracingCCRep pc e.propCC)

theorem tracingMsgRep_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option TraceMsg) : Persistent (tracingMsgRep p o)

def isTraceLogger (γt : GName) (tl : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜tl = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨
      ∃ l,
        ⌜tl = GoInterface.ok l⌝ ∗
          □
            ∀ p e Q,
              tracingEventRep p e -∗
                AU <{ ∃∃ L, traceAuth γt L }> @ ⊤, ∅ <{ traceAuth γt (L ++ [e]), COMM Q }> -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal (methods l.ty go!"TraceEvent" l.v))
                      (intoVal p))
                    {{ v, ⌜v = intoVal ()⌝ ∗ Q }})

structure TraceCC : Type where
  changes : List (GoString × GoString)
  newconf : List GoString

structure TraceMsg : Type where
  typ : GoString
  term : w64
  frm : GoString
  to : GoString
  entries : w64
  logTerm : w64
  index : w64
  commit : w64
  vote : GoString
  reject : Bool
  rejectHint : w64

theorem isTraceLogger_persistent (γt : GName) (tl : GoInterface) : Persistent (isTraceLogger γt tl)

theorem tracingPropsRep_persistent (m : GoMap) (e : TraceEv) : Persistent (tracingPropsRep m e)

def tracingCCRep (p : Loc) (o : Option TraceCC) : IProp GF :=
  match o with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some c =>
    iprop(∃ g chs,
        typedPointsto p g DFrac.discard ∗
          ownSlice g.Changes' chs DFrac.discard ∗
            ⌜List.map (fun x => (x.NodeID', x.Action')) chs = c.changes⌝ ∗ ownSlice g.NewConf' c.newconf DFrac.discard)

theorem tracingCCRep_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option TraceCC) : Persistent (tracingCCRep p o)

theorem trace_alloc : ⊢ |==> ∃ γt, traceAuth γt [] ∗ traceFrag γt []

def traceFrag (γt : GName) (L : List TraceEv) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γt (Qp.half 1) L

def traceEv_countable : Pos.Countable TraceEv :=
  countableOfLeftInverse
    (fun e =>
      (e.name, e.nid, e.term, e.vote, e.commit, e.role, e.logSize, e.conf, e.msg, e.cc, e.propCC, e.propMatch,
        e.propNext))
    (fun p =>
      { name := p.fst, nid := p.snd.fst, term := p.snd.snd.fst, vote := p.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        commit := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, role := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, logSize := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        conf := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, msg := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        cc := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst, propCC := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        propMatch := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.fst,
        propNext := p.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd.snd })
    traceEv_countable._proof_1

theorem trace_agree (γt : GName) (L1 L2 : List TraceEv) : ⊢ traceAuth γt L1 -∗ traceFrag γt L2 -∗
    ⌜L1 = L2⌝

def traceAuth (γt : GName) (L : List TraceEv) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γt (Qp.half 1) L

def tracingMsgRep (p : Loc) (o : Option TraceMsg) : IProp GF :=
  match o with
  | none => iprop(⌜p = null⌝)
  | some m =>
    iprop(∃ g,
        typedPointsto p g DFrac.discard ∗
          ⌜g.Type' = m.typ ∧
              g.Term' = m.term ∧
                g.From' = m.frm ∧
                  g.To' = m.to ∧
                    g.EntryLength' = m.entries ∧
                      g.LogTerm' = m.logTerm ∧
                        g.Index' = m.index ∧
                          g.Commit' = m.commit ∧ g.Vote' = m.vote ∧ g.Reject' = m.reject ∧ g.RejectHint' = m.rejectHint⌝)

def traceCC_countable : Pos.Countable TraceCC :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun c => (c.changes, c.newconf)) (fun p => { changes := p.fst, newconf := p.snd })
    traceCC_countable._proof_1

theorem isTraceLogger_nil (γt : GName) : ⊢ isTraceLogger γt GoInterface.nil

theorem tracingEventRep_persistent (p : Loc) (e : TraceEv) : Persistent (tracingEventRep p e)
